recent_tweets.text:
exploring ways to spin up agents from my phone

iOS shortcuts × github actions × cursor cli

world_signals: open weights teaching tiny world models to hold a lucid minute of motion
May light over the bay, cool marrow air warming toward an afternoon crest
clear skies and restless breeze sketching errands down long blocks
stutter-house pockets threaded with dreamy pop on familiar headphones
founding-role posts flickering past like marquee bulbs in startup feeds
git-quiet weekend while shortcuts and Actions hum in standby

composer-2-fast.concept: Drag a luminous droplet along converging ribbons of Karl-the-Fog that pulse like a gated house hook; snag phosphor seeds before the marine layer slams shut.
composer-2-fast.mechanic: Steer-drag through squeezing luminous lanes while timing pickups to invisible beat accents.
composer-2-fast.touch_control: Thumb drag anywhere to steer the droplet.
composer-2-fast.session_hook: Each 45s tide brings a tighter near-miss duet between fog walls and shimmering pickups.
composer-2-fast.escalation: Lanes braid, pickups phase-shift off-beat, and wind vectors tilt the ribbons diagonally.
composer-2-fast.aesthetic: Neo-noir pastel fog glass over Pacific spring twilight.

gpt-5.5-extra-high.concept: A single-row stutter sequencer: tap blooming nodes only when the phantom grid halves, thirds, then sneaks triplets.
gpt-5.5-extra-high.mechanic: Rhythm subdivisions with strict windows and brief afterimages you must reject.
gpt-5.5-extra-high.touch_control: Single-finger taps on drifting nodes anchored to the beat lattice.
gpt-5.5-extra-high.session_hook: Chain clean windows to unlock a cascading bloom animation that resets the tempo map.
gpt-5.5-extra-high.escalation: Swing percentage drifts; ghost echoes demand ignored taps every other bar.
gpt-5.5-extra-high.aesthetic: CRT-line bloom and CMYK rave ink on velvet black.

claude-opus-4-7-thinking-max.concept: Trace one unbroken contour to cradle fragile ink blossoms before SF sun dries them flat.
claude-opus-4-7-thinking-max.mechanic: Single-stroke enclosure puzzle with overlapping hazards and disappearing petals.
claude-opus-4-7-thinking-max.touch_control: Draw-and-release path carving; reroll wipes the ink budget.
claude-opus-4-7-thinking-max.session_hook: Each solved loop gently unfurls synced audio grains like tape pitch-up.
claude-opus-4-7-thinking-max.escalation: Thorns chase the nib, petals shrink faster, dew timers spark chain penalties.
claude-opus-4-7-thinking-max.aesthetic: Sumi watercolor macro with tactile paper fibers.

gemini-3.1-pro.concept: Flick command-orbs into gravitational wells labelled like shortcuts; combos arc through chained agent icons before decay.
gemini-3.1-pro.mechanic: Angled physics flick with decaying magnets and orbital assists.
gemini-3.1-pro.touch_control: Pull back and release for vector shots; subtle aftertouch spin via micro drag.
gemini-3.1-pro.session_hook: Every three-well chain spawns a celebratory constellation trace across the hud.
gemini-3.1-pro.escalation: Gravity inverts pulses, wells shrink, sabotage wells steal spin.
gemini-3.1-pro.aesthetic: Wireframe celestial mechanics over soft gradient void.
